summary_1line: Valmiki recounts how King Saudasa was tricked by a Rakshasa into serving human flesh to Vasishtha and was cursed to suffer the consequences.

image_candidates.scene_text: A disguised Rakshasa presents a dish of human flesh to the unsuspecting King Saudasa during the Ashwamedha sacrifice.
The sage Vasishtha, blazing with anger, raises his hand to curse King Saudasa after realizing he has been served human flesh.
King Saudasa, stopped by Queen Madayanti, spills the cursed water on his own feet, which become darkly stained.
